thread:
Priya Singh: Heads-up — intake for a customer-driven PRD. Customer (FinCloud) is asking for explicit launch acceptance criteria tied to their contract. Need to capture problem statement, goals, non-goals, success metrics, and edge cases so legal + sales can sign off. Who can help scope?
Marco Chen: I can help. quick Q: are they asking for SLA (uptime/latency) or functional acceptance (behavior/regression) or both?
Sam Patel: Both. They want a contract clause: 'model must meet p99 latency and NPS on hallucination tests' — paraphrasing their customer success rep.
Priya Singh: Problem statement (draft): "FinCloud will onboard sensitive customer workflows on Dedicated. They require contractual acceptance criteria for throughput and behavioral regressions before go-live." Need feedback.
Alice Kline: Non-goals (proposal): "No model retraining or ongoing model improvement guarantees from Redwood — we only commit to preserved model artifact + runtime config." Keep that explicit.
Jonah Park: Proposed success metrics (initial):
- perf: p99 latency <= 150ms at 200 concurrent streams for 95% of 72-hr rolling windows
- reliability: 99.9% uptime on Dedicated pools for the month after launch
- quality: hallucination rate <= 4% on provided eval suite, with <1% regressions vs baseline after rollout
Those map to contract items.
Priya Singh: Nice. Need acceptance criteria phrased so legal can verify. Suggest listing pass/fail checks and who runs them (Redwood eval team + customer).
Nate W: Engineering constraints/risk: Dedicated pools are multi-tenant by default — their ask for network isolation and deterministic latency might need Dedicated single-tenant or pinned GPUs. Cost/time impact: +3-6 weeks depending on capacity.
Marco Chen: Implementation acceptance checklist (draft snippet):
```
- Run 72-hr soak with customer traffic (or replay) at 200 conc. streams -> measure p99.
- Run customer eval harness v1.2 across 10k prompts -> measure hallucination rate.
- Verify KV cache warmup time < 30s for common prefixes.
- Confirm canary fallback: if p99 degrades by >20% automatically route to fallback model.
```
Jonah Park: Edge cases to call out: cold-start spikes (first 30 requests), degraded GPU performance (thermal throttling), and model param mismatch if customer pins a different checkpoint. Add acceptance rules for each.
Sam Patel: For legal, also include rollback criteria and remediation SLAs (e.g., revert within 2 hours, RCA within 5 business days).
Priya Singh: Launch criteria (proposal):
- All checklist items pass with telemetry captured and reproducer artifacts archived.
- CS + customer sign-off on quality events.
- SRE runbook validated and a post-launch hypercare window scheduled (2 weeks).
Alice Kline: Non-functional success metrics to include: observability retention window for token-level traces (30 days minimal for the contract), and access controls (KMS integration validated).
Nate W: Engineering ask: need a capacity reservation ticket for Dedicated single-tenant cluster and estimated cost delta for Sales. I'll draft the ticket.
Priya Singh: Decision needed: do we treat this as "Dedicated single-tenant" (longer delivery, higher cost) or "Dedicated with strict isolation configs" (faster, possible perf variability)? Opinions? @Marco @Jonah
Marco Chen: Strongly prefer single-tenant for contractual clarity. Reduces ambiguity for acceptance tests.
Jonah Park: Agree on single-tenant for this contract. We'll flag cost/time in PRD.
Priya Singh: OK — action items:
- Marco to write acceptance criteria section in PRD (due EOD tomorrow).
- Nate to open capacity/reservation + rough ETA.
- Sam to capture exact customer contract language and add to PRD appendix.
- Alice to add non-goals + observability acceptance language.
- Jonah to add edge cases + rollback criteria.
Sam Patel: I'll ping FinCloud for final wording and attach their eval harness.
deploy-bot: build #infra-dedicated-reservation 521 started by Nate W — ETA 4h
Priya Singh: Thanks all — I'll assemble the PRD draft once those items are in. If anyone sees additional legal asks (RTO/RPO specifics), drop them here. :thumbsup:
